import datetime as dt
from freezegun import freeze_time

# Scenario: freeze at 2023-10-15 14:00 UTC
# In +11:00 timezone, local time is 2023-10-16 01:00
# So "today" in +11:00 is Oct 16

with freeze_time("2023-10-15 14:00"):
    tz = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=11))
    
    # What is "now" in +11:00?
    now_plus11 = dt.datetime.now(tz)
    print(f"Now in +11:00: {now_plus11}")
    print(f"Today in +11:00: {now_plus11.date()}")
    print(f"UTC today: {dt.date.today()}")
    
    # Test case: datetime(2023, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=+11:00)
    aware_dt = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=tz)
    print(f"\nTest datetime: {aware_dt}")
    print(f"Test date: {aware_dt.date()}")
    print(f"Delta from tz-today: {(aware_dt.date() - now_plus11.date()).days}")
    print(f"Delta from UTC-today: {(aware_dt.date() - dt.date.today()).days}")
    
    # Another test: datetime(2023, 10, 17, 1, 0, tzinfo=+11:00) 
    aware_dt2 = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 17, 1, 0, tzinfo=tz)
    print(f"\nTest datetime 2: {aware_dt2}")
    print(f"Test date 2: {aware_dt2.date()}")
    print(f"Delta from tz-today: {(aware_dt2.date() - now_plus11.date()).days}")
    print(f"Delta from UTC-today: {(aware_dt2.date() - dt.date.today()).days}")
